title: Czy mógłby pan…? · zwroty
note: Situations/chunk unit — the politeness register, riding b1_conditional_sg. MÓGŁBY QUARANTINE (James's standing fence): mógłby/mogłaby are taught STRICTLY as parts of two whole opaque openings — Czy mógłby pan…? / Czy mogłaby pani…? — exactly as pan/pani address was handled in a2_ordering_func. One line of English orientation only ('you can hear the by of chciałbym inside it, but this verb is irregular — take the whole opening ready-made'); móc's conditional is NEVER paradigmed: no mógłbym, no mogłabyś, no plural, no derivation from mogę, no four-way ending drill anywhere. Every quiz choice touching the frames is a WHOLE SENTENCE. Only the two 3rd-person surface forms are tagged. The learner produces nothing but the frozen frames. NO plural conditional anywhere (fenced to b1_conditional_pl); oni/one still untaught and absent. DROPPED: 'Poproszę o…' — o is taught as LOCATIVE (o_loc: o pracy, o siódmej), so an o + Accusative frame is a live homograph trap on a function word, and plain Poproszę + noun (a2_shopping_func) already does the identical job; the frame buys nothing and risks the o the learner owns. Not replaced. KEPT WHOLE: 'Przepraszam, że przeszkadzam.' — że and przeszkadzam both verified untaught (check_new), so the sentence is a frozen block like Nie słyszę: one honest gloss line (że = that, przeszkadzam = I'm disturbing), never built, przeszkadzać never conjugated, że never used to build any other sentence. KEPT AS ONE NEW WORD IN A KNOWN FRAME: 'Chciałbym zapytać, …' — zapytać verified untaught, taught here as the infinitive 'to ask' after the recycled chciałbym/chciałabym; it is perfective but no aspect content is attached to it (poproszę precedent); the tail after the comma is always a question already owned whole (gdzie jest bank / ile to kosztuje). KEPT WITH ONE-LINE ACC LINK: 'Dziękuję (bardzo) za + thing' — za verified untaught, taught as 'for'; the noun takes the mam-form, which is the TAUGHT accusative (miec_acc), stated in one line exactly as a2_shopping_func did for Poproszę kawę — no new case machinery. KEPT FROZEN: 'Nie ma problemu.' — problemu verified untaught as a form; 'nie ma + genitive' was never taught as a rule, so the phrase is fixed; the explain points at the familiar -u of do banku without stating any new rule. KEPT: Oczywiście, verified untaught, one opaque politeness word. Real contrast the unit DOES teach: Dziękuję → Nie ma za co (already taught) vs Przepraszam/request → Nie ma problemu (taught here). Word order: the frames keep the contiguous order Czy mógłby pan mi pomóc? — mi-before-pan is also natural Polish, but the contiguous frame keeps the chunk in one piece for the learner; logged as an authoring choice. check_new run 2026-08-05: mógłby, mogłaby, zapytać, przeszkadzam, oczywiście, za, że, problemu all NEW; pomóc (trunk_can_a1, infinitive 'to help' — same function here), mi (a2_dat_chunks, dative 'to me' — same function), pan/pani (leaf_home_family + a2 address use — same function), prezent/obiad/dworzec all recycled as taught.

intro.title: Czy mógłby pan…? · Czy mogłaby pani…? — the polite could-you
intro.title_pl: Czy mógłby pan…? Czy mogłaby pani…?
intro.body:
This is how you ask a stranger for something in Polish without sounding blunt: Czy mógłby pan…? to a man, Czy mogłaby pani…? to a woman — "Could you…?" The pan and pani are the same polite words you have used since Co pan poleca?

You can hear the by of chciałbym inside mógłby — good ear — but this verb is irregular, so do not build anything: learn each opening ready-made, as one block, and never change it.

After the opening comes a plain infinitive you already own: pomóc, mówić, zrobić. And mi is the same mi as in smakuje mi — "to me". Czy mógłby pan mi pomóc? — Could you help me?

intro.title: Chciałbym zapytać… · Przepraszam, że przeszkadzam. — the two openers
intro.body:
Two ways to open on a stranger politely, and you own most of both already.

Chciałbym zapytać, … = "I would like to ask, …" Chciałbym is last unit's word; zapytać — "to ask" — is the one new word here, an infinitive that follows it exactly as kawę did. After the comma, put any question you already have: Chciałbym zapytać, gdzie jest bank. A woman says Chciałabym zapytać, … — the same gender split you already make.

Przepraszam, że przeszkadzam = "Sorry to disturb you." Word for word it is "I'm sorry that I'm disturbing" — że means that, przeszkadzam means I'm disturbing — but you never need to build it. It is said exactly as it stands, every time. Learn it whole.

intro.title: Dziękuję bardzo za… — thanking for the thing
intro.body:
Dziękuję bardzo you have said a hundred times. To name what you are thanking for, add za — "for" — and then the thing.

One rule, and you already own it: after za the thing takes the same form it takes after mam. Mam kawę → Dziękuję za kawę. That is the accusative doing the same job it always does — for most masculine and neuter words it changes nothing at all: za prezent, za obiad.
intro.body_pl: Dziękuję bardzo za kawę. Dziękuję za prezent.

intro.title: Oczywiście. · Nie ma problemu. — saying yes politely
intro.body:
The other side of the conversation: what comes back when someone asks you.

Oczywiście = "Of course." The warm yes to any request: — Czy mógłby pan mi pomóc? — Oczywiście.

Nie ma problemu = "No problem." A fixed phrase — learn it whole. The -u on the end is the same shape you see in do banku, but nothing here needs building; say it exactly as it stands.

And keep your two replies apart. Someone thanks you → Nie ma za co, the reply you already have. Someone apologises or asks for something → Nie ma problemu.

quiz.prompt: You stop a man in the street — could he help you? You say:
quiz.explain: Pan is for a man, the same pan as in Co pan poleca? The whole opening Czy mógłby pan is one ready-made block.

quiz.prompt: Now you are asking a woman for help. You say:
quiz.explain: Pani is for a woman, and the opening changes with her: Czy mogłaby pani. Learn the two openings as two whole blocks.

quiz.prompt: — Czy mógłby pan mi pomóc? — ___ (you agree to help)
quiz.explain: A request gets Oczywiście — of course. Nie ma za co is the reply to being thanked, not to being asked.
An apology gets Nie ma problemu — no problem. It is a fixed phrase, said exactly as it stands.

quiz.prompt: The polite two-step version of Gdzie jest dworzec? — a man speaking:
quiz.explain: Chciałabym is a woman speaking — the same gender split as in the last unit. The question after the comma stays exactly as you already say it.

quiz.prompt: Thank you very much for the coffee. →  Dziękuję bardzo za ___.
quiz.explain: After za the thing takes the same form as after mam: mam kawę → dziękuję za kawę. The accusative you already own, in one more place.
Keep the two replies apart: thanks gets Nie ma za co; an apology or a request gets Nie ma problemu.
Zapytać means to ask — the one new word of this opener. Like every verb after chciałbym, it stays a plain infinitive.

quiz.explain: The pan opening plus the infinitive mówić you already own. Po angielsku names the language you are asking for.
One fixed sentence — word for word "I'm sorry that I'm disturbing" — but you never build it. Say it whole, every time.
